name: HH regime-switch 04 — realized-vol EXPANSION regime → trade momentum (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM (the expansion LEG of the vol-regime switch): in a high realized-vol expansion regime order flow is directional — breakouts and trend persistence dominate as momentum-chasing leverage piles in and slow institutions reprice. The counterparty you front-run is a slow institution still filling. This spec ONLY trades momentum, and ONLY when vol_realized is in its upper regime (above a fitted expansion floor) AND ADX confirms an actual trend (not just noisy high vol). Entry: vol_realized high AND adx high AND ret_Nd positive. Exit: ADX collapses (trend dies) or vol_realized falls back into the neutral/contraction band (regime flip), or stop/TP/time. This is the pair to variant 06 (the contraction reversion leg); together they are the switch. DISCONFIRMER: momentum's edge in the top realized-vol tercile must independently clear the Gate net of fees; if it only survives when pooled with the contraction leg (one leg carrying a dead leg), the 'switch' is a curve-fit label. Also kill if the expansion breakpoint must be re-fit per-asset to work — a real regime uses one global threshold.
catalyst: high realized-vol expansion with a confirmed trend — directional flow to ride
